ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface covering approximately 90% of the visible fluke, with high-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at distal tips and scattered across the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central area consists of a contiguous dark pigment field; high-intensity white clusters (rosettes) are located at both left and right distal tips; a localized cluster of white speckling is visible on the lower-right lobe; several discrete high-contrast circular rings are mapped to the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 1:7 relative to fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge maintains a relatively smooth macro-boundary with low-amplitude, low-frequency serrations; micro-irregularities and peaks increase in density toward the terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a strong convex sweep; the trailing edge follows a concave trajectory from the median notch vertex before transitioning to a convex curve near the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-intensity white circular rosettes (barnacle clusters) at both distal tips; scattered white circular ring scars with dark centers are visible on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (likely rake marks) oriented diagonally on the right lobe and horizontally on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of barnacle colonization at the terminal ends of both lobes; multiple distinct circular scar rings on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white-pixel speckling field localized to the lower-right quadrant, adjacent to the water-line occlusion.
